requirements.title: Sales Dashboard Home Screen
requirements.description: The Sales Dashboard Home Screen displays key performance indicators, a pipeline widget, and an activity feed.

requirements.title: Revenue Forecast
requirements.description: Revenue forecast with AI-driven prediction and confidence intervals

requirements.title: Sales Rep Leaderboard
requirements.description: Sales rep leaderboard with ranking by revenue, deals closed, and activities

requirements.title: Pipeline Conversion Funnel
requirements.description: Pipeline conversion funnel showing drop-off rates between stages

requirements.title: Report Builder Workflow
requirements.description: User navigates to Reports > 'New Report'. Selects primary data source and drags fields into Columns, Rows, Filters, and Values zones. Live preview updates with each change.

requirements.title: Scheduled Report Delivery
requirements.description: Scheduled report delivery via email in PDF or CSV format

requirements.title: Report Sharing
requirements.description: Report sharing with role-based access control

requirements.title: Cross-Object Reporting
requirements.description: Cross-object reporting joining leads, contacts, deals, and activities

requirements.title: Sales Activity Metrics
requirements.description: Sales activity metrics: calls made, emails sent, meetings held per rep

requirements.title: Response Time Analytics
requirements.description: Response time analytics for lead follow-up SLA compliance

requirements.title: Deal Entity Screen
requirements.description: The Deal Entity Screen displays deal information, including deal ID, name, company ID, primary contact ID, pipeline ID, stage ID, value, currency, probability, expected close date, actual close date, won, loss reason, owner ID, created at, and updated at.

requirements.title: Lead Capture Web Form
requirements.description: A web form that captures lead information, including name, email, company, and source, and sends it to the Lead Service for processing.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Includes performance and scalability requirements such as Dashboard Page Load Performance, Global Search Performance, Email Sync Latency, Report Generation Performance, and System Uptime SLA.

requirements.title: GDPR Compliance
requirements.description: The platform must comply with GDPR requirements including right to erasure, data portability, consent management, and DPA availability.

requirements.title: Email Integration
requirements.description: Includes Gmail API OAuth 2.0 Integration, Microsoft Graph API Integration, and other email-related functionalities.

requirements.title: Calendar Integration
requirements.description: Includes Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar Sync for meeting scheduling.

requirements.title: Lead Management Workflow
requirements.description: Includes lead assignment, lead conversion, and lead nurturing processes.

requirements.title: Search Functionality
requirements.description: The Search Functionality allows users to search for leads, contacts, deals, and activities using full-text search with fuzzy matching and highlighting.

requirements.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture
requirements.description: Multi-tenant architecture using tenant_id column on all tables to enforce tenant isolation at the database level

requirements.title: Tenant Data Capacity
requirements.description: A single tenant can store up to 5 million contacts and 500,000 deals without performance degradation.

requirements.title: API Access and Rate Limiting
requirements.description: All API access must be via OAuth 2.0 with scoped tokens, and API rate limiting must be 100 requests/minute per user and 10,000/minute per tenant.

requirements.title: Cross-Region Database Replication
requirements.description: The platform must have cross-region database replication with automatic failover.

requirements.title: Webhook Delivery Guarantees
requirements.description: The platform must guarantee at-least-once webhook delivery with HMAC-SHA256 signature, and retry failed webhooks for 72 hours.

requirements.title: Email Tracking UI
requirements.description: A UI component that displays email tracking information, including open tracking and click tracking.
